items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: I know of him, but he don't know me as good as his daddy did.

ctx.x: Well, you know the young Jim LaRocca.

I know of him, but he don't know me as good as his daddy did. His mother, he'd tell me, I didn't know Miss Lena, she, the automobile was running and he got out the car, something like that, it looked like the car was running to the lady and running through the wall or something like that. I've heard so many different things.
